title: Local two-peer VPN: synthetic receive boundary
goal: Learner-written Go IPv4 structural parsing followed by authenticated source authorization and recording-sink tests, before QUIC/TUN integration. Current exact contract covers milestone 1 only; agree subsequent policy and handler signatures before implementation.

milestones.title: Parse one IPv4 packet safely
milestones.requirements: Implement ParseIPv4(packet []byte) (IPv4Info,error) in package vpn. IPv4Info has HeaderLength int, TotalLength int, Source [4]byte, Destination [4]byte. Reject without panicking len<20, version !=4, IHL<5, IHL*4>len, TotalLength<header length, or TotalLength != len. Decode total length big endian. Return exact lengths and addresses for structural success; fields on error ignored. Require exact structured equality on success, non-nil error on rejection; error wording ignored. Options opaque; no checksum, fragmentation or authorization checks. Length means len, not cap. No QUIC/TUN. Harness consumes saved cases; future review cases remain within this contract.
milestones.nextAction: Create your own Go module named localvpn in project/local-vpn (the harness imports localvpn), then create package vpn, IPv4Info and ParseIPv4 yourself using the documented interface. No source files or module manifest are supplied. Run go run ./harness from project/local-vpn after setup. Tests/data are ready; missing module/source errors are expected until you create them. No learner correctness verification yet.
hints: Use RFC791 layout: high nibble of byte0 is version, low nibble IHL in four-byte words; bytes2:4 big-endian total length; bytes12:16 source and16:20 destination. Check input lengths before access; compare decoded lengths as int, never narrowed len or cap.

milestones.title: Authorize sources before packet injection
milestones.requirements: After structural milestone, agree authenticated-peer policy representation, handler/sink interface and exact acceptance/rejection behavior. Implement source authorization plus recording-sink tests proving unauthorized packets cause zero writes. Do not begin until contract and fixtures agreed.
milestones.nextAction: Agree source policy and receive-handler interface after milestone 1 passes review and understanding check.
